messages:
alex: hitting a weird one — customer on go-sdk v0.9.2 sees intermittent 502s followed by a flurry of 401s after token refresh. can repro locally with a simple loop.

alex: repro steps:
1) long-running client with shared http.Transport
2) background token refresher that updates global auth header
3) requests get 401, SDK retries, and then we see h2 GOAWAYs and connection resets

alex: minimal repro code:
```go
client := &http.Client{
    Timeout: 10 * time.Second,
    Transport: &http.Transport{
        MaxIdleConns: 100,
        IdleConnTimeout: 90 * time.Second,
    },
}
req, _ := http.NewRequest("GET", url, nil)
req = req.WithContext(ctx)
resp, err := client.Do(req)
```

morgan: thanks — is the SDK retrying on 401? that can cause token refresh dance + h2 GOAWAY
sam: can you paste the logs you saw?
alex: logs from customer box:
"2026-03-10T14:22:31Z ERROR request failed: 401 token expired; retrying"
"2026-03-10T14:22:31Z WARN http2: server sent GOAWAY and closed the connection"
"2026-03-10T14:22:31Z ERROR request failed: 502 upstream read error after body"

sam: sounds like a race between the token refresh goroutine and the request retry using the same transport. connection gets reset, client retries, server sends GOAWAY, repeat.
sam: common culprits: cancelling parent ctx too early, client.Timeout shorter than total time to refresh+retry, or SDK retry policy that retries on auth error instead of initiating refresh.

irina: quick mitigations we tried in staging: 
1) upgrade SDK to v0.11.0 (fixes retry ordering around auth refresh)
2) tune Transport: set IdleConnTimeout lower and MaxIdleConnsPerHost to avoid long reuse spikes
3) ensure refresh happens synchronously for the request that encountered 401 (avoid background racing)

morgan: another trick for repro was to force http1.1 (disable HTTP/2) by setting Transport.TLSNextProto = map[string]func(string,*tls.Conn)http.RoundTripper{} — that reduced h2 GOAWAY noise but didn't fix root cause.

alex: forcing HTTP/1.1 reduced frequency but still saw 502s on heavy concurrency. switching off client-level automatic retries for 401 and handling refresh inline fixed it for the customer.

support-bot: escalated to eng-platform as INC-2642 (owner: @sam) — adding logs and timeline.

sam: follow-ups for eng: add metric for "auth_refresh_retry_count", make SDK not treat 401 as idempotent retry target by default, and add a configurable hook for token refresh so callers can control blocking behavior.

alex: customer accepted workaround (disable retry-on-401 + SDK upgrade). they'll schedule an upgrade next week. thanks all :thumbsup:
